Hardening, after an audit of the web app and the server's endpoints.

### Fixed
- **Book descriptions are sanitized.** They are rendered as HTML and come out of files downloaded
  from the internet. Scripts never ran, but a description could still render an `<iframe>`, an
  off-site `<form>`, a remote `<img>` or a `<style>` block — a tracking pixel reporting who read
  what, a phishing prompt on a page the reader trusts, or a repaint of the app around them. The
  formatting a description legitimately uses is kept; everything else is dropped.
- **The web app now carries security headers**: a content security policy (no framing of the app,
  no off-site form posts, no third-party images or frames, no plugins), `nosniff`, and a referrer
  policy.
- **`secure_session_cookie`** (new setting, off by default) sends the session cookie with the
  `Secure` attribute, so browsers only return it over HTTPS. Turn it on if your server is behind
  HTTPS; leaving it off keeps plain-HTTP setups working.

### Also
Eight integration tests now cover what this fork adds — multi-folder libraries, series merging,
content rules, Unicode and author search, per-book reading direction, the PWA manifest and the
update check — so an upstream merge that unhooks one of them fails the build instead of shipping.
